product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper Press Fit 45 Degree Male/Female Elbow
product.description: Designed to help you fit your pipes together at a 45° angle, this Xpress copper 45° press street elbow is perfect for you! With a quick and easy installation process, this fitting has a totally heat-free jointing system which means no solders, adhesives, or hot works when being applied.Not only will the clean internal bore save you time on cleaning and long preparation, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue - this lessens the risk of your street elbow corroding and increases longevity and durability. This product is ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects. product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip Coupling
product.description: This Xpress copper press slip coupling is perfect for connecting copper pipes together. It uses a press tool method that doesn’t need any additional solders, adhesives, or hot works to install and utilises a slip feature that lets the fitting slide over the pipe. This means that your experience will be quick, safe, and easy without long preparation times. Not only does the clean internal bore mean less cleaning, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue – this lessens the risk of corrosion while simultaneously increasing longevity and durability. Xpress products are ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects, and the systems don’t need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing. product.name: Xpress Copper Chrome S12SCP Press Street Elbow
product.description: This S12SCP Press Street Elbow offers an array of benefits and unparalleled convenience for various plumbing applications. This advanced fitting ensures major savings in installation time and cost compared to traditional jointing methods. The heat free jointing system eliminates the need for solders, adhesives, compounds, gas, hot works permits, or costly insurance. With Xpress, you get clean, rapid, and safe jointing without complicated clamping techniques, lengthy preparation, or waiting for adhesives to dry.Safety is paramount with no naked flames required, reducing risks associated with high temperature working. The Xpress system ensures a perfectly clean internal bore, minimizing the need for additional finishing or cleaning. There are no carbon deposits, internal solder runs, or flux residues, significantly reducing corrosion risks. Additionally, the system doesn't need to be dry for effective jointing. Xpress fittings are widely approved, including Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW, and they assure electrical continuity upon completing the jointing process. Ideal for domestic maintenance, refurbishment, new builds, and large-scale public sector projects, Xpress fittings provide unmatched versatility and reliability.Features & Benefits: Xpress Copper Chrome S12SCP Press Street ElbowMajor savings, reduced installation time and costHeat free jointing, no additional solders, adhesives, or flames requiredWide approvals, includes Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW certifications

product.name: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid
product.description:
Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid is a concentrated, high-performance solution manufactured for Air and Ground Source Heat Pump systems, based on ethylene glycol. This advanced fluid ensures a prolonged system lifespan by providing superior corrosion and limescale protection. Notably, it offers frost protection ranging from -10°C (25% concentration) to an impressive -33°C (50% concentration), allowing users to adjust protection levels depending on specific requirements.
Apart from its frost-resistant attributes, Fernox HP-EG enhances energy efficiency with its lower viscosity compared to propylene glycol alternatives. This results in reduced energy consumption during fluid circulation, contributing to both cost savings and environmentally conscious operations.
Features & Benefits: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer FluidA concentrated, high-performance fluid for Air and Ground Source Heat Pumps based on ethylene glycolWill prolong your system's lifespan with superior corrosion and limescale protectionFrost protection from -10°C to -33°C, adjustable based on concentration (25% to 50%)Enhances energy efficiency with lower viscosity, reducing fluid circulation energy consumptionOutstanding pH buffering maintains optimal pH for mixed-metal systemsSeamless compatibility with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems
The fluid's outstanding pH buffering capabilities maintain an optimal pH level for mixed-metal systems, preventing corrosion and ensuring system health. Fernox HP-EG is a cost-effective solution prioritising thermal efficiency, making it a wise choice for those seeking reliable performance within budget constraints. It seamlessly works with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems.
Please note: Dilute before use using mains water. Deionised water (demineralised) or artificially softened water is also suitable if preferred. To ensure adequate corrosion protection, the minimum ‘in-use’ concentration is 25%.Frost protection levels can be checked using a Fernox Refractometer. Existing heating systems should be cleaned of sludge and limescale deposits with a suitable Fernox Cleaner before adding Fernox HP-EG.

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire C9414 Equal Tee
product.description:
This equal tee is from the Pegler VSH power press range, which is a system designed for thick wall steel pipe. Installations are quicker by up to 80% when compared with welded or threaded, as well as less technical, and there is no hot permit necessary,. Installation can be carried out on a wet system. It is suitable for Galvanised, Red oxide or self colour tube and can be used on heating, cooling and compressed air. Available in PWR9400248 ½”, PWR9400259 ¾”, PWR9400261 1”, PWR9400270 1 ¼”, PWR9400281 1 ½” and PWR9400292 2”, this equal tee is versatile.
